We are ~6–8 focused turns away from a finished, stable MetaBlooms OS (v1.0 failure-first).
That assumes no new scope, just closing what is already designed and partially wired.

What “finished” means (so we’re aligned)
When I say finished, I mean:

✅ Failure-first axioms fully enforced across all engines, not just Teaching

✅ Planning, Compiler, and Promotion loops cannot lie, skip, or self-validate

✅ Session persistence is hardwired, not aspirational

✅ One vertical slice"
